items.name: Double Dice
items.description: Roll two dice this turn.

items.name: Custom Dice
items.description: Choose your roll: 1 to 6.

items.name: Steal
items.description: Take 10 coins from a player of your choice.

items.name: Pick the Target
items.description: The next question round is about a player you choose.

items.name: Shield
items.description: Automatically blocks the next steal or negative event.

items.name: Peek
items.description: During a question: see how many picked each answer so far (never the target's).

items.name: Wide Tolerance
items.description: During a number question: your answer gets double tolerance.

items.name: Star Warp
items.description: Teleport right in front of the star, then roll.

items.name: Sprint Shoes
items.description: +3 steps on this turn's roll.

items.name: Push Back
items.description: Push a player of your choice back 4 spaces.

items.name: Swap Places
items.description: Swap places with a player of your choice.

items.name: Freeze
items.description: A player of your choice skips their next turn.

items.name: Triple Dice
items.description: Roll three dice this turn.

items.name: Coin Magnet
items.description: Take 3 coins from every other player. Costs 2 + 2 per other player.

items.name: Star Thief
items.description: Steal a star from a player of your choice.

items.name: Lucky Charm
items.description: During a question: double the coins you win from it.

items.name: Star Coupon
items.description: Your next star costs 10 coins less (used automatically).

items.name: Bank Heist
items.description: Grab the whole Piggy Bank pot from anywhere.

items.name: Copycat
items.description: In a question: pick another guesser. You lock in whatever they lock in.

items.name: Mirror
items.description: Bounces the next item used on you (steal, push, freeze, swap…) back at whoever used it.

items.name: Toll Booth
items.description: Build a toll on your tile: everyone else who passes or lands there pays you 3 coins, for the rest of the game. One Toll Booth per tile.

items.name: Star Radar
items.description: See where the star goes next after someone buys it. Only you see it.

items.name: Swapper
items.description: Take a random item from a player. They get a random item from the shop instead.
